title: Hold a pharmacy business licence and trade from licensed premises
what: Own or carry on a pharmacy business only under a pharmacy business licence for that business, and carry it on only at or from licensed premises (s 20).

sources.title: Pharmacy Business Ownership Act 2024 (Qld)
sources.quote: A person must not own a pharmacy business unless the person holds a pharmacy business licence for the business that is in effect

sources.title: Pharmacy Business Ownership Act 2024 (Qld)
sources.quote: A person must not carry on a pharmacy business unless the business is a licensed pharmacy business

sources.title: Pharmacy Business Ownership Act 2024 (Qld)

sources.quote: The council may grant an application for a pharmacy business licence for a pharmacy business only if satisfied— (a) the applicant— (i) is an eligible person;

reach.condition: if it owns or carries on a pharmacy business
